full_page.content:
1929, May
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
(extra page)
Page 51
May 21st. A. REMARKABLE RAIN. M. Wade of St. Michael's Parish - Montgomery, Indiana enrolled said parish for good crops. At the time things looked very hopeless - really desperate. At once the rainy spring stopped. Corn, etc was planted and grew well but the drouth threat- ened. The parish was enrolled again that it might have rain. It did rain but to the astonishment of observers it only fell to the parish limits.
P.S. March 11 - 1945. Note -
Above M. Wade - now Mrs. Ryan - had been active promoter of Ser. Mass Ass'n here in Detroit .... Working for Graham Page Co., had quelled strikes as - overnight.
Aug. 7th Mrs. McDonald's Property to sell.
Wm. J. Spooner 38 - in Harper Hosp. - given up. uremic poison. Mrs. Borowski 57 in Harper Hosp. prayed for two weeks ago, then not expected to live - intestinal cancer .... now O.K.
Laura Whalen - Operation To-day F1. Clary - Pontiac - Goiter Vogley - Epileptic. -
END OF NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
